## Scope

The public-repository audit is read-only and does not clone or execute target repository code. It reports bounded public evidence and explicit limitations; it is not a penetration test, security certification, legal opinion or compliance assessment.


## Interactive free audit
- https://ossabellator.github.io/claude-code-mcp-hardening/free-audit.html
- Zero-signup browser audit for one public GitHub repository.
- Reads bounded public GitHub metadata and configuration evidence; does not clone or execute the target repository.
